title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 Sharon Stone La Toya Jackson + 1 Bonus Magazine
descriptionText:
Description

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1990–1993 featuring major actresses, models and entertainers including Sharon Stone, La Toya Jackson and Victoria’s Secret supermodel Stephanie Seymour.

Includes:

July 1990 – Sharon Stone
Sharon Stone cover and pictorial from early in her Hollywood career. Also features a Quincy Jones interview by Alex Haley, an article on the cast of Married… with Children, Aaron Neville, and Jacqueline Sheen as Playmate of the Month. This is one of the more collectible issues in the lot, with comparable ungraded copies recently selling around $9–$15. 

November 1991 – La Toya Jackson
La Toya Jackson cover with an all-new pictorial and material from her autobiography. Also includes a Sean Penn interview, 20 Questions with Julia Roberts, and a feature on the life and crimes of a Mafia prince. 

August 1992 – All-American Housewife Issue
Salute to the All-American Housewife issue featuring Margie Murphy on the cover and Ashley Allen as Playmate of the Month. Also includes Girl Talk, an interview with Derek Humphry, a feature on Ross Perot, and Sex Sells: How Madison Avenue Gets Our Attention. 

February 1993 – Stephanie Seymour
Victoria’s Secret supermodel Stephanie Seymour cover and pictorial. Also features a Danny DeVito Playboy Interview, 20 Questions with Tim Allen, Jennifer LeRoy as Playmate of the Month, and the Sheer Fantasy lingerie feature. 

All four are original vintage newsstand issues with barcodes.

Pre-owned vintage condition with normal age and handling wear. Covers show some light surface, edge and corner wear. Overall they display well for their age. Please review the photos closely for the exact cosmetic condition.

You will receive the exact four magazines pictured.

Great collection for Playboy collectors as well as fans of Sharon Stone, La Toya Jackson, Stephanie Seymour, vintage supermodels and 1990s pop culture.
